$sources: ECP 201-2012 Table 8.9 (importance classes and the importance factor γI)
source: ECP 201-2012 Table 8.9: γI = 0.8 (minor buildings), 1.0 (ordinary buildings), 1.2 (buildings of large occupancy: schools, assembly halls), 1.4 (buildings vital after an earthquake: hospitals, fire and police stations, power plants). SAEngine's categories I-IV take them in order. The wind importance stays 1.0 (the parent's BS 6399-2 Sp).

I.description: Minor buildings of low occupancy (agricultural, temporary) (γI = 0.8)

III.description: Buildings whose collapse affects many people (schools, assembly halls, cultural buildings) (γI = 1.2)

IV.description: Buildings vital after an earthquake (hospitals, fire and police stations, power plants, communication centres) (γI = 1.4)

sources.categories: ECP 201-2012 Table 8.9 (check the uses of each class)
